CustomField.description: Where each signer role signs, as placed by the sender in Send for Signature: JSON list of {role, page, x, y, height} in PDF points (page from 0; x, y = bottom left of the signature area). Blank: signers sign at their {{sig:Role}} tags. The PDF itself is not changed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Signature places chosen by the sender when sending. Blank when the document's anchor tags were used as they are.
CustomField.label: Field Layout
